title: Ballet Variation Tutorial | "Grand Pas Classique" Female Variation Beginners 2020

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor guides students through a full beginner variation step-by-step with clear counting and verbal cues. She breaks down complex turns and positions while demonstrating facing forward and explaining posture.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Grand Pas Classique female variation for beginners
Step-by-step breakdown of posture, arms, and footwork
Full demonstration of the variation with music

common_mistakes: Going up and down instead of staying at the same level during transitions

steps_taught.name: demi-plie
steps_taught.description: Bending knees while keeping heels on the floor

steps_taught.name: pas de bourree
steps_taught.description: Quick sequential steps on pointe or demi-pointe changing feet

steps_taught.name: releve
steps_taught.description: Rising onto demi-pointe or pointe from straight legs or plie

what_works: Clear breakdown of counts and positions
Repetition of steps on both sides
what_hinders: Rapid transition between complex combinations without pausing for student practice

quotes.text: Today I have a very easy version of the variation and I'm sure that you're going to enjoy it.
And we are going to repeat everything to the left.
Now we don't go up and down, we just stay plie and we stay the same level.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor talking directly to the camera introducing the lesson
Demonstrating initial positions and demi-plie with arms in fifth position

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining detailed verbal positioning with continuous demonstration at a slow instructional pace before adding full musical accompaniment.
